notes.title: Mercedes-Benz Pack out now!
notes.content:
Get the Mercedes-Benz Pack now and don’t miss out on the best that the German company can offer: powerful and elegant racing cars on and off the track. The pack features 2016 Mercedes-AMG GT3, 2019 Mercedes-Benz A-Class, 1993 Mercedes-Benz E 36 AMG Estate Custom and 1971 Mercedes-Benz 300 SEL 6.8 AMG, for an incredible mix between yesterday’s emotions and today’s adrenaline. Four vehicles ready for every track and every driving style. Add the Mercedes-Benz Pack to your collection and you’ll go from AMG to OMG at full speed!

This DLC includes:

[list]
[*] 2016 Mercedes-AMG GT3
[*] 2019 Mercedes-Benz A-Class
[*] 1993 Mercedes-Benz E 36 AMG Estate Custom
[*] 1971 Mercedes-Benz 300 SEL 6.8 AMG
[/list]

notes.title: Alien Encounters Expansion Pack now available!
notes.content:
They will tell you it doesn’t exist, that this place is just the creation of some lunatic’s imagination. But it’s all true. Hangar 68 is out there! You can believe it… and you can race in it! Get captured by the mysterious allure of a secret military base housing a real unidentified flying object. And much more!

Uncover all the mysteries concealed within the [b]Alien Encounters Expansion Pack[/b]: a mega underground hangar spanning 3 levels to race through the wreckage of a UFO, suspended walkways, and ventilation systems, explore rooms and laboratories filled with surprises, and experience close encounters with out-of-this-world fun!

All of this, aboard “well-identified road objects” like the Hiway Hauler™ 2, a powerful compact truck; Test Subject™, a monster truck ready for any challenge; Speed Slayer™, the embodiment of speed in a vehicle; and Swamp Buggy, with its unconventional look for racing on any terrain.

We may not yet know if there’s life in the universe, but one thing’s for sure: there’s plenty of fun in Hangar 68!

This DLC includes:

[list]
[*] [b]1 Environment to build your tracks
[*] 4 Vehicles: Hiway Hauler™ 2, Test Subject™, Speed Slayer™, Swamp Buggy
[*] 1 new area to add to the Hot Wheels™ Creature Rampage mode
[*] Background, Profile icon, Tag and Card Background to further customize your Unleashed Profile![/b]
[/list]
This DLC is included in the HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 – Season Pass Vol. 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187578/2848e82178173ee6c3811d4b6581214186336bc6.png[/img]

notes.title: Old But Gold Pack available!
notes.content:
Some of you might have seen them on the streets. Maybe the youngest player will discover them here for the first time. But it’s never too late to find yourself face to face with true legends.

Those who love racing, but above all those who love cars built to be masterpieces of power and muscle on 4 wheels, certainly cannot miss the [b]Old but Gold Pack[/b], featuring no less than the 1994 Bugatti EB110 SS, the legendary Lancia Delta HF Integrale, the Lancia Stratos Group 5 and the Nissan Skyline GT-R R32.

Four racing cars born when cars were still all asphalt, gas, screeching tyres and pure driving pleasure. A dive into the past which promises you a future full of victories! Add these must-have pieces to your collection!

This DLC includes:

[list]
[*] 1994 Bugatti EB110 SS
[*] Lancia Delta HF Integrale
[*] Lancia Stratos Group 5
[*] Nissan Skyline GT-R R32
[/list]

This DLC is included in the HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 – Season Pass Vol. 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187578/5ae7f2171fa02f1e99672a486b0973423b473592.png[/img]

notes.title: AcceleRacers Free Pack 2 out now!
notes.content:
Deezel Riggs’ second car in the AcceleRacers series, the Piledriver™ takes its name from a ruthless wrestling move that leaves no opponents a chance: they are flipped and crushed to the ground. Likewise, Piledriver™ can turn any situation around and take out the competition on the track in an instant.

An open-structure single-seater that reveals the engine and NO2 tanks for extra power.
Technetium™ is instead a beauty from Team Silencerz that needs no introduction.

Actually, it would need it, but many of its characteristics remain a mystery, as per Silencerz tradition. The only thing that won’t be a mystery is that it will take you straight to the podium!

[b]Add AcceleRacers Free Pack 2 to your collection![/b]

This DLC includes:

[list]
[*] Piledriver™
[*] Technetium™
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187578/47d05e108004d95c3a7d7bbd0de055481de7cc08.png[/img]

notes.title: Fast&Furious Pack out now!
notes.content:
It’s not just any garage.

Of course, you’ll see tools, shelves, tables, spare parts, and equipment to enhance cars… but you’ll also find a BBQ and the iconic 1970 Dodge Charger.
Experience Fast & Furious, the high-speed street racing saga, amidst all muscle speedsters and a crew bound by loyalty.
And the 1970 Dodge Charger R/T won’t just be in the garage, but it will also be part of your collection, ready to leave some tyre marks on the asphalt!
Alongside it, you’ll find the unforgettable Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 and 95 Mitsubishi Eclipse, as well as the stunning supercar W Motors Lykan HyperSport.

Enter Dom’s Garage and unleash the fury of hundreds of horsepower with the unmissable [b]HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 – Fast & Furious Expansion Pack[/b].

This DLC includes:

[list]
[*] 1 Environment to build your tracks: Dom’s Garage;
[*] 4 Vehicles: Nissan Skyline GT-R R34, 1970 Dodge Charger R/T, 95 Mitsubishi Eclipse, W Motors Lykan HyperSport;
[*] 1 new area to add to the Hot Wheels™ Creature Rampage mode;
[*] Background, Profile icon, Tag and Card Background to further customise your Unleashed Profile!
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2524820/HOT_WHEELS_UNLEASHED_2__Fast__Furious_Expansion_Pack/

notes.title: Highway 35 World Race Pack out now!
notes.content:
Straight from the movie [b]Highway 35 World Race[/b], 4 spectacular racing cars will make the competition tremble even before starting their engines.

Their aerodynamic and futuristic design is the perfect appetiser for what will later be the main course: a never experienced before power on the track, ready to devour the opponents as if they were peanuts. 24/Seven™, tireless as the name suggests; Power Pistons™, an all-powerful single-seater born for the most demanding tracks; Sling Shot™, ready to sprint towards the finish line; Vulture™, made to hit its opponents like a bird of prey.

Add the Highway 35 World Race Pack to your collection and harness the full power of these extraordinary 4-wheeled masterpieces!

This DLC includes:

[list]
[*] [b]24/Seven™
[*] Power Pistons™
[*] Sling Shot™
[*] Vulture™[/b]
[/list]
This DLC is included in the HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 – Season Pass Vol. 2.

notes.title: Made in Italy Expansion Pack out now!
notes.content:
A small village on the most characteristic Italian coastline, where the days pass slowly, strolling through narrow alleys, and enjoying a sunny lunch on the terrace… is about to be shaken by the adrenaline-fueled excitement of the craziest races ever! Meet in the square to kick off the show and discover the hidden corners of this wonderful Italian village, with its restaurants, shops, and the church bell tower.

Experience the thrills of racing behind the wheel of Italian-made speedsters like the Alfa Romeo 155 V6 TI and Lancia 037, or choose to enjoy the Dolce Vita aboard the legendary Fiat 500D Modificado or the iconic Vespa 90 SS Super Sprint (1966).

Among roof tiles, bricks, and stones, get ready to show everyone what you’re made of with the [b]Made in Italy Expansion Pack[/b]!

This DLC includes:

[list]
[*] 1 Environment to build your tracks: Italian Village;
[*] 4 Vehicles: Alfa Romeo 155 V6 TI, Lancia 037, Fiat 500D Modificado, Vespa 90 SS Super Sprint (1966);
[*] 1 new area to add to the Hot Wheels™ Creature Rampage mode;
[*] Background, Profile icon, Tag and Card Background to further customise your Unleashed Profile!
[/list]
